title: The oldest bark cloth beater in southern China (Dingmo, Bubing basin, Guangxi)
lineage: Source-identified note paraphrases the accessible publisher-rendered abstract and preview, not the full article. The age is contextual to the layer, not a directly dated surviving cloth.

passages.note: Abstract and article preview: an in-situ grooved stone interpreted as a barkcloth beater; layer value 7898 ± 34 BP, whose calibration status is not specified in this abstract.
